updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: A certificate validation flaw in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows authorized attackers to bypass security features over the network. Admins managing PKI infrastructure should apply patches promptly to prevent certificate-based attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-118148: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services was discovered and updated with corrected CVSS scoring. Identity admins should review and patch affected AD infrastructure to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680: Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: A spoofing vulnerability in Windows NTLM authentication allows attackers to impersonate users on the network; Microsoft Office applications are now included in the affected software list. Admins should prioritize patching systems relying on NTLM for authentication to prevent identity spoofing attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96082: Windows Kerberos Denial of Service Vulnerability
updates.summary: A denial of service vulnerability was identified in Windows Kerberos authentication. Admins should review and apply available patches to prevent disruption to authentication services.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling SharePoint Library Default Labels
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview will automatically apply default sensitivity labels configured on SharePoint document libraries to existing files at rest. This feature closes labeling gaps and enforces consistent, secure-by-default data classification without manual user intervention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Sync Status SLA Reduction to 30 Minutes
updates.summary: Admins will see updated Endpoint DLP policy sync status in the Purview UI within 30 minutes instead of the previous 2-hour window. This faster feedback loop helps security teams validate policy deployment more quickly.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Communication Compliance Alert Customization
updates.summary: Communication Compliance now enables admins to customize alert frequency per policy and adjust email alert recipients during policy creation. This granular control helps organizations tailor compliance monitoring to their governance workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling Support for Legacy Office File Formats
updates.summary: Server-side auto-labeling now supports legacy Microsoft Office formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) in SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling organizations to automatically classify and protect older file formats. This expands coverage for organizations managing mixed file format environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive Mailbox Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Auto-expanding archive mailboxes can now grow beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and scalable archive growth for E5-licensed customers. This addresses storage constraints for large-scale retention environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Admins can now view per-policy coverage reports showing which files have been labeled, remain unlabeled, and how enforcement correlates with simulation data. This visibility helps track auto-labeling progress and identify gaps in policy coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery Premium Hold Reports for U.S. Government Clouds
updates.summary: Out-of-the-box hold reports for eDiscovery cases are now available in U.S. Government cloud environments, allowing admins to view, sort, filter, and export information about all legal holds associated with cases. This improves litigation readiness and audit capabilities.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Version Trimming for Retained SharePoint and OneDrive Files
updates.summary: Authorized Purview RBAC admins can enable version cleanup for OneDrive and SharePoint content covered by retention policies, reducing storage bloat while maintaining compliance promises. This policy-scoped setting allows version management even when retention is active.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Network DLP Scoping via Entra GSA Internet Access
updates.summary: Admins can now scope network data security DLP policies to all websites or exclude specific cloud apps through Entra GSA Internet Access integration, extending protection to unmapped and custom cloud applications. This broadens DLP coverage beyond the Defender Cloud App Catalog.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Automated Deletion of Inactive User OneDrives and Mailboxes
updates.summary: Admins can now automatically delete both content and containers for departed users at scale, ensuring regulatory compliance without manual intervention. This streamlines offboarding workflows for large organizations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Microsoft Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) are now accessible through Microsoft Graph APIs, providing a unified view across multiple archive locations ahead of EWS Graph API deprecation in October 2026. This eases API migration for applications managing large archive environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Monitoring for FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now monitors sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols with configurable restrictive actions. This extends data protection capabilities to legacy file transfer methods commonly used in regulated industries.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109467: Azure DevOps Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication flaw in Azure DevOps Server allows authorized attackers to execute remote code over the network. Identity and DevOps admins should apply patches to prevent unauthorized code execution and lateral movement.
